title: Sampler
when: Home, craft, care, heritage and patience: a lesson or a history stitched one cross at a time

voice.style: gentle, warm and patient, like reading a letter aloud

rules: Shapes are cross-stitched on linen: the canvas mosaic default lays each in Xs on one even grid; stroke colour outlines the motif.
Stitch things in: enter assemble with build sweep, row by row, the way a sampler is worked.
Frame every scene with a stitched border (art: {sketch: "sampler-border"} under the block) and keep motifs simple: a house, a heart, a tree, an alphabet row.
Text stays native type in the serif faces, set like an inscription under the motif; never stitch words people must read.
Two or three thread colours per scene: accent (madder red), accent2 (indigo) and ink.
